baselineSummary.qualification: All cases remain within existing gates; the perturbation still changes routing, complexity, fidelity and time. Candidate comparisons are separate.

findings: All-valid controls reproduce the baseline geometry in both repeats for all four masks.
One ignored corner pixel changes puppy from 3+5 to 5+5 cuts and Hunodan hjfig-05 from 4+4 to 6+6; both still pass existing gates with worse full-mask error and longer solve time.
The separate existing bird-eye fixture loses its eye and another small region in both missing-pixel runs. Lower whole-mask error does not establish feature preservation.
Observed feature weighting/scheduling restores puppy 3+5 counts and bird-eye retention. Direct native grid resampling alone does not restore those routings.
Both individual corrections and their combination still fail to restore the simpler, faster Hunodan result. Its unperturbed fit uses traced MILP recovery, which the weighted-input guard disables.
No candidate is integrated. Combined puppy error varies between repeats, and the restored bird has higher total error than the baseline although its eye component IoU improves.
visualReview: Puppy baseline versus missing-corner exports inspected: extra border irregularities and changed outline/routing remain visible.
Bird baseline, missing-corner and combined exports inspected: eye disappears in the weighted-input baseline and returns with the candidate. Remaining frame and seam defects are not resolved.

interruption.reason: Free-space preflight below 2 GiB before next fit; no failed fit or partial result.

resumption: Free space recovered to 2.87 GiB. Verified all 12 complete records and 1,381 original source pins; resumed only the six unfinished fits. No source, artifact or result was deleted.

next.purpose: Canonical proposals outside observed pixels, weighted source scoring through traced recovery and its refinement, plus ignored-colour flips.

qualification: Native fixed-mask experiments, not cropper or browser timing benchmarks. Partial real crops and free-border cases still need checks before integration; no new 31-photo success-rate claim.
